tagline: AI-powered observability and security platform for cloud applications
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the Hero because it reflects the company's ability to retain customers and grow revenue from its existing customer base, which is a key driver of growth through the land-and-expand model.
company_description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.summary: Unfavorable economic conditions may impact the company's growth and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: The company states that unfavorable economic conditions could negatively affect its business growth and operating results. Macroeconomic events including changes in trade policies, inflation fluctuations, and interest rates may slow customer IT spending. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition may affect the company's ability to acquire new customers and grow sales with existing customers.
risks.score_rationale: The company notes that competition is a key factor in acquiring new customers and expanding sales with existing ones. The effectiveness and pricing of competing products may impact acquisition and expansion capabilities. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Technology and Innovation
risks.summary: Reliance on technology may affect the company's ability to maintain its leadership position and innovate.
risks.score_rationale: Datadog's success depends on its ability to maintain a leading position in technology and innovation. The company must continue developing its platform with over 20 products and maintain differentiation. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Contract Non-Renewal Risk
risks.summary: The risk of contract non-renewal may affect the company's revenue.
risks.score_rationale: Subscription contracts are typically monthly or annual, and customers may choose not to renew. The net retention rate reflects the significance of this risk, although currently positive at 120%. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Revenue Fluctuation Risk
risks.summary: Revenue fluctuation risk may affect the company's financial stability.
risks.score_rationale: Revenues may fluctuate due to revenue recognition over the subscription contract term. The subscription model creates potential variability based on contract cycles. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: International Expansion Risk
risks.summary: International expansion risk may affect the company's ability to grow operations globally.
risks.score_rationale: Datadog intends to expand its operations internationally, which may present risks related to geopolitics, regulation, and operational complexity. (default score, to be refined)
